run_test_math_plugin: run the Math test class to verify the m.math Pelican plugin renders LaTeX math correctly
run_test_code_fallback: run the test_code_fallback method to verify math renders as code when M_MATH_RENDER_AS_CODE is True
run_test_cached_math: run the Cached test class to verify the math plugin uses and updates the pickle cache file
run_test_uncached_math: run the Uncached test class to verify the math plugin populates a fresh cache from LaTeX rendering
review_pelican_plugin_testcase: review the PelicanPluginTestCase base class and its subclasses Math, Cached, and Uncached for test patterns
